Prevention: Plant herbicide resistant (Imazapyr resistant - IR) maize varieties:
Longe 7H-IR (Kayongo-go), NARO Maize 58-IR, 59-IR, 60-IR Improve soil fertility using nitrogen fertilizer such as
Urea, NPK, CAN Practice crop rotatation with legumes or root crops like groundnuts, beans, lablab or sweet potatoes
Keep or control traffic out of maize farm by people and animals
Clean all equipment thoroughly on a designated area on the farm or use 1% bleach (chlorine) and wash down with pressure cleaner
Ensure field sanitation such as weeding, removal of debris
Dig trenches on garden periphery to control runoff
Monitoring: Inspect/scout the field of maize and record observations every 14 days
Striga after every14 days with purple or red flowers
Observe possible symptoms on the plants like stunted growth with premature yellow leaves
Direct Control: Rouge the weed and burn especially before flowering stage
Uproot the weeds before flowering every 14 days
Use clean tools and equipment like tractors, hoes to uproot all striga weed before they flower
Plant trap plants such as silver leaf
Desmodium ( D. uncinatum ) between maize spaces and nappier grass on the periphery
Intercrop maize with cotton, lablab or castor - these induce weed growth
Restrictions: Read the chemical label for application rate and mixing procedure.
Always check for the expiry date.
Cannot be used in mixed cultures, e.g. in legumes mixed with corn, since it is phytotoxic to cotyledons.
